title: The Toy Chicken
setting: A cosy family kitchen with a fireplace on Christmas morning.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

sentences.en: On Christmas morning, Ben hears a terrible sound.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节早上，本听到一个可怕的声音。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) covers his ears in a hallway decorated for Christmas, looking toward the kitchen.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben covering his ears in a Christmas hallway; the sound itself can't be shown.

sentences.en: Someone is in the kitchen near the fire.
sentences.zh: 有人在厨房里，就在炉火旁边。
sentences.scene_prompt: A shadowy figure stands near a warm fireplace in a kitchen while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) peeks around the door.

sentences.en: His mother Anna holds a single toy chicken.
sentences.zh: 他妈妈安娜手里拿着一只玩具鸡。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan), wearing a green apron, holds up one yellow toy chicken and squeezes it near the fireplace.

sentences.en: The poor boy laughs and hugs the toy.
sentences.zh: 可怜的小男孩笑了，抱住了玩具。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) laughs with relief and hugs the yellow toy chicken.

sentences.en: It is hard, but he loves it so much.
sentences.zh: 它硬邦邦的，但他非常喜欢它。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) knocks on the hard plastic toy chicken with his knuckles and smiles widely.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben knocking on the plastic toy and smiling; how hard it is and how much he loves it can only be guessed.

sentences.en: Of all his gifts, he likes it most.
sentences.zh: 在所有礼物里，他最喜欢它。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits among opened Christmas gifts and holds the toy chicken high above the others.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben holding the chicken above his other gifts; 'most' is only suggested.

sentences.en: "Please drink your milk now," says Anna.
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) hands a glass of milk to Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), who still holds the toy chicken.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Anna handing Ben a glass of milk; the spoken request can't be shown.
